title: Flood Susceptibility Mapping using GIS & Remote Sensing
description: Multi-criteria spatial analysis for flood risk assessment in low-lying coastal zones using ArcGIS Pro and Google Earth Engine. Applied Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) with eight conditioning factors.

title: Land Use Land Cover Change Detection
description: Temporal analysis of LULC changes over 30 years using Landsat imagery to assess urban expansion and its environmental impacts on peri-urban agricultural land.

title: Urban Heat Island Effect Analysis
description: Thermal band analysis to identify urban heat islands and propose green infrastructure interventions for climate resilience in secondary cities.

title: Spatial Analysis of Urban Waterlogging
description: GIS-based assessment of urban waterlogging patterns and drainage infrastructure analysis in Khulna city using DEM data and hydrological modeling.

title: Coastal Vulnerability Index Mapping
description: Assessment of coastal vulnerability using multi-parameter spatial index integrating physical, social, and economic indicators for the coastal districts of Bangladesh.

title: Vegetation Health Monitoring with NDVI
description: Time-series NDVI analysis using Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8 data to monitor vegetation health changes across urban and peri-urban areas.
